entities.name: Failure Information procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the UE to inform the network about a failure detected by the UE.

entities.name: FailureInformation message
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network to report detected failures.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that detects a failure and initiates the Failure Information procedure.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that receives failure information from the UE.

relations.description: The Failure Information procedure includes sending the FailureInformation message.
The UE initiates the Failure Information procedure when it detects a failure.
The FailureInformation message is sent from UE to network to report failures.
